meta.title: Aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ — 149-146 send Ɛisa
meta.desc: Amenɣi apunik wis krad : lekkes n leslaḥ, aḥeṛṣ n krad iseggasen, Scipion Émilien, aɣelli n Byrsa, Hasdrubal akked tmeṭṭut-is, tamacahut n lmelḥ akked users aṛumani.
hero.title: Aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: Ayen i texdem Ṛuma, akked ayen i tenna texdem : amenɣi apunik wis krad, seg lekkes n leslaḥ n temdint armi d times n Byrsa.
hero.alt: Agraw apuni n tiɣilt n Byrsa
hero.caption: Agraw apuni n Byrsa, yettwasserɣen deg 146
stats.0.t: n uḥeṛṣ, seg 149 armi d tafsut 146 send Ɛisa
stats.1.t: n leslaḥ akked 2000 n yisebbaren ttunefken i Ṛuma uqbel umenɣi
stats.2.t: d sețța iḍan n umenɣi deg iberdan armi d Byrsa
stats.3.t: n wid i d-yeffɣen seg Byrsa, ttwazenzen d aklan
cato.text: Yuɣal-d seg uɛeggal deg Tafrikt, ihuz-it ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ i d-yuɣalen, Caton yesmed yal taɣect-is deg Ssenaṭ s umeslay-agi. Akken i d-yeqqar Plutarque, yesken-d tazarin tifrinin yegzem-itent qrib Qarṭaǧ krad wussan uqbel : aɛdaw iqrib ɣer lbabur. Scipion Nasica yeẓẓuɣuṛ, mgal-s, ad tettwaselk tamdint.
myth.title: Ahelak n tidet, mačči ahdem akmilen
myth.text: Ṛuma tesserɣ terẓa Qarṭaǧ, tenɣa neɣ teg d aklan imezdaɣ-is. Maca taqsist n temdint « yeqqimen ɣer wakal » yettwaseflen s lmelḥ d tamacahut : ikecfan ufan-d tamdint tapunit ddaw n temdint taṛumanit, tgemmi tapunit teqqim tedder leqrun.
massi.title: Masinisa, aεeggal-nniḍen n uɣelli
massi.intro: Ṛuma tefka tiwtilt taneggarut, maca d agellid anumidi Masinisa i yettaken, deg xemsin iseggasen, lkamel n tmurt n Qarṭaǧ, yefkan daɣen i Ṛuma laṣel-is.
massi.alt: Idrimen n Masinisa, agellid n Numidya
massi.caption: Idrimen n Masinisa — British Museum
massi.why: Masinisa yebɣa ad yebnu tagelda tanumidit tameqqrant yezdeɣ wakal, s timdinin akked tmurt n yirden. Maca igrudan yesɛan lɣella akked lxiwanat tirikin akteṛ n Tafrikt llant d ayla n Qarṭaǧ, i yeqqimen ssɛaya-ines ɣas mi tettwanɣelb. Yesεa laman belli s laṣel n Ṛuma, yal aṭṭef ad yeqqim war aḥkam.
massi.rows.0.v: Yesselmad di Qarṭaǧ akken i d-yeqqar Appien, yennuɣ fell-as di Hispanya mgal At Scipion.
massi.rows.1.v: Qarṭaǧ teɛawen aɛdaw-is Syphax ; Masinisa yeddu ɣer tama n Ṛuma.
massi.rows.2.v: Ineggafen-ines inumidiyen d imeḥttam di Zama : ttuɣalen ttɛerḍen lɛesker n Hanibal seg deffir.
massi.rows.3.v: Amtawa n talwit yesserreḥ-as ad yessuter « timura n yimezwura-s », war tilisa ibanen, yegdel i Qarṭaǧ amenɣi war laṣel n Ṛuma : Qarṭaǧ ur tezmir ara ad teḥdar iman-is weḥd-s.
massi.rows.4.v: Yeṭṭef amur n Emporia, lxiwanat tirikin n Tiflilt Tameẕyant (Tite-Live). Ṛuma tazen imesfahmen ur yefran.
massi.rows.5.v: Qarṭaǧ tesmeyya i Ṛuma : deg sin iseggasen, Masinisa yekkes-as ugar n 70 n temdinin d lqwaɛed (Tite-Live).
massi.rows.6.v: Aṭṭef amaynut n Emporia ; Ṛuma tefka ṣṣwab i Masinisa, Qarṭaǧ teṭṭuḥettem daɣen ad as-texles 500 n ttalan (Polybe).
massi.rows.7.v: Yeṭṭef Tiẓgi Timeqqranin akked tmurt n Thugga, azal n xemsin n temdinin (Appien). Lεeggalet taṛumanit i d-yusan ad tefrez, akked Caton, teɣleb texdeɛ belli ilaq ad tettwahdem Qarṭaǧ.
massi.rows.8.v: Teεya, Qarṭaǧ tezzi azal n 25 000 n yirgazen ddaw n Hasdrubal. Yezzi yeεya, lɛesker yeqbel ; ineggafen n Gulussa, mmi-s n Masinisa, nɣan imeḥbas. I Ṛuma, d arrez n lemɛahda n 201 i tgerri.
massi.rows.9.v: Masinisa yemmut qrib n 90 iseggasen, deg ammas n uḥeṛṣ n Qarṭaǧ. Scipion Émilien yefraq tagelda-ines ger warraw-is.
massi.hannibal: Qarṭaǧ ur tesεi ara ugar amsellek ilhan akteṛ : mi gettwafren d asufet, Hanibal yesfaḏ taneddawt yerra idrimen deg umkan-nsen, maca iɛdawen-is msellen-t i Ṛuma. Yeffeɣ ɣer berra deg 195 yemmut deg 183, drus uqbel amenɣi aneggaru.
massi.rome: Ṛuma tesseqdac Masinisa war ma tebɣa ad as-teǧǧ Qarṭaǧ. Aṭas n yimesnezruyen imaynuten ttwalin belli ahelak n temdint yebɣa daɣen ad yesgdel tagelda tanumidit, ihuddun aṭas, ur tt-teṭṭef : asmi yemmut, tagelda-ines tettwafraq imir-nni kan.
def.title: Leḥras n Qarṭaǧ
def.intro: Uqbel uḥeṛṣ, atan ayen i teṭṭuḥettem Ṛuma ad teṭṭef : tamdint yettwabnan ɣef tigzirt tamecṭuḥt, yesekkṛen ɣer tama n wakal s yiwet seg leḥras tizmarent akteṛ n ddunit taqdimt. Ssebbat-agi i yesbeggnen amek temdint war leslaḥ tḥares qrib krad iseggasen.
def.map.aria: Tugna n tigzirt tamecṭuḥt n Qarṭaǧ : krad n tyirza n leḥras deg webrid aẓayan, lḥiḍ n lebḥer, lqelɛa n Byrsa, lebḥura akked wemḍiq uḍεif n lḥiḍ
def.map.caption: Asnulfu n tugna — ẓẓiwan d lemqyasat ur yettwassenen s tidet, s telqey n Polybe akked Appien.
def.appian.title: Krad tyirza n lḥiḍ n webrid aẓayan
def.appian.rows.0.v: Azal n 25 n stades (≈ 4,5 km) akken i d-yeqqar Polybe (I, 73) akked Appien : d amkan-nni kan ara d-yekcem s wakal.
def.appian.rows.1.v: 30 n yidḍan (≈ 13 ɣer 14 m) i yal lḥiḍ, war ma neḥseb lḥiḍan imeẓyanen d tgejdal.
def.appian.rows.3.v: Yiwet yal sin plèthres (≈ 60 m), yesεa kuẓ iḥedrayen.
def.appian.rows.4.v: Tiɣerman i 300 n ilfan akked lqut-nsen.
def.appian.rows.5.v: Tiɣerman n 4000 n yiyisan akked lxezniyen n ciεir d waɣanim.
def.appian.rows.6.v: Amḍiq i 20 000 n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar akked 4000 n yineggafen.
def.appian.note: Krad lḥiḍan yemsaεdalen ? Appien yura deg lqern wis 2 mbeɛd Ɛisa s telqey n Polybe, acehhed n uḥeṛṣ. Aṭas n yimesnezruyen imaynuten ttwalin leḥras yemεeddayen : laglaḍ, lḥiḍ amezwaru neɣ lḥiḍ n tezwart, imbeɛd lḥiḍ ameqqran s tgejdal i yeḥeznen lkazirnat akked tiɣerman.
def.tiles.0.title: 34 km, amḍan ara tsemdeḏ
def.tiles.0.text: Amḍan i yettwabedren aṭas yekka-d seg Tite-Live (Periochae, 51) : lḥiḍ n 23 n yimil iṛumaniyen, azal n 34 km. Orose yeḥseb 22 (≈ 32,5 km) ; Strabon, netta, yefka 360 n stades (≈ 65 km) i uzzig n tigzirt meṛṛa. Ẓẓiw akmel ur yettwaf ara : ad nini lḥiḍ n azal n tlatin km, yezgi agraw-ajennan n Mégara.
def.tiles.1.title: Yiwen kan n lḥiḍ
def.tiles.1.text: Anida lebḥer akked yidurar sentren tamdint, lḥiḍ usrid yezga (Appien). Amḍiq uḍεif : azellaw adday yettwattun anida lḥiḍ-agi yemlal akked ufednas n wakal yeddan ɣer lebḥura. Dinna i yezzi akunsul Censorinus imgezmen-ines deg 149 ; aɣẓaṭ yettwasd deg wammas n yiḍ, lhuǧum yerreẓ.
def.tiles.2.title: Byrsa, aḥris aneggaru
def.tiles.2.text: Deg ul n temdint, tiɣilt n Byrsa tesεa lḥiḍ-ines s yiman-is, ɣef lǥameɛ n Eshmoun ; Orose yefka-yas azgen n sin yimil n tezzi (≈ 3 km). Deg 146, d aḥris aneggaru n wid yettwaḥeṛṣen.
def.tiles.3.title: Cothon, leḥras n lebḥer
def.tiles.3.text: Lebḥer snat akked tkalin-is i 220 n lbabura ttwaseknen deg usebter n users. Deg uḥeṛṣ, uɣalen d ssebba n umenɣi : Scipion yesekkeṛ tawwurt-nsen s lseqqa, wid yettwaḥeṛṣen gezmen abrid amaynut.
def.tiles.4.title: Ayen d-ufan ikecfan
def.tiles.4.text: Ɣer tama n lebḥer, ikecfan iwermaniyen n Friedrich Rakob (agraw n Magun, teklal n UNESCO) kksen-d lḥiḍ n lebḥer n lqern wis 5 send Ɛisa akked tewwurt teldi ɣef rrif. Ɣef webrid aẓayan, aneɣlaf Duval yeḍfeṛ deg 1949 ẓẓiw n leḥras n azal n 2,9 km, yesεa-t d lḥiḍ berranan apunik.
def.tiles.5.title: « Lḥiḍ n Théodose »
def.tiles.5.text: Mačči akk lesswar i yettwakecfen di Qarṭaǧ d ipuniyen. Azal n 425 mbeɛd Ɛisa, ddaw n Théodose II, Qarṭaǧ taṛumanit tesεa lḥiḍ amaynut zdat lhuǧum n Ivandaliyen ; tarbaɛt takanadit tkecf-it seg 1976. Ulac azday ger-s d lesswar n 146.
war.title: Ayen yeḍran
war.events.0.title: Aɛnaq.
war.events.0.desc: Qarṭaǧ tfukk axleṣ n lxedima n umenɣi teḥdar iman-is, s leslaḥ deg ifassen, mgal tikcumin n ugellid anumidi Masinisa. Ṛuma ttwalin deg-s arrez n lemɛahda n 201, yegdel-as amenɣi war laṣel-is.
war.events.1.title: Lekkes n leslaḥ d uḥettem aneggaru.
war.events.1.desc: Ikunsulen Manilius akked Censorinus rsen ɣer Utique, i yeddan ɣer tama n Ṛuma. Qarṭaǧ tefka 300 n imeḥbas, 200 000 n leslaḥ akked 2000 n yisebbaren. Ṛuma tessuter imir-nni ad ǧǧen tamdint ad tettwabnu daɣen ɣer 80 n stades (azal n 15 km) seg lebḥer. Iqarṭaǧiyen ugin.
war.events.2.title: Tamdint tezzi leslaḥ.
war.events.2.desc: Azal n ṣṣfeṛ meṛṛa yellan yettwakelyi iwakken ad ixdem leslaḥ imaynuten ; akken i d-yeqqar Appien, tilawin gezzment acwawen-nsent iwakken ad gent tsiɣdin n yisebbaren. Lhuǧumen iṛumaniyen imezwura rrẓen, skud Hasdrubal yeḥrez tiẓgi.
war.events.3.title: Scipion Émilien.
war.events.3.desc: Yettwafren d akunsul ɣas akken d ameẓyan, mmi-s n mmi-s yettwarban n Scipion Ufrikan yesnerna aḥeṛṣ yesekkeṛ tawwurt n lebḥer s lseqqa. Wid yettwaḥeṛṣen gezmen abrid amaynut ɣer lebḥer zzin lebḥer yettwabnan s laman.
war.events.4.title: Lhuǧum aneggaru.
war.events.4.desc: Iṛumaniyen ṭṭfen amḍiq n lebḥura imbeɛd n Agora. Deg sețța wussan d sețța iḍan, kemmlen axxam s wexxam ɣef krad n yiberdan i yalin ɣer Byrsa, sserɣen ixxamen mi ten-ṭṭfen.
war.events.5.title: Aɣelli n Byrsa.
war.events.5.desc: 50 000 n yirgazen d tilawin ffɣen seg lqelɛa fkan iman-nsen. Azal n 900 n Iṛumaniyen irewlen qqimen deg lǥameɛ n Eshmoun gren-as times.
war.events.6.title: Mbeɛd tanyafit.
war.events.6.desc: Tamdint tesserɣ aṭas n wussan ; tajmaɛt n mraw n yimeqqranen n Ssenaṭ tesres tsfaḏ ayen i d-yeqqimen tenɛal amḍiq. Tamurt tuɣal d tamanaḏt taṛumanit n Tafrikt, s Utique d taneddawt ; idlisen ttunefken i igelliden inumidiyen. Deg useggas-nni, Ṛuma tehdem Corinthe.
end.title: Wussan ineggura
end.aside: Polybe, amdakel d umcawar n Scipion, yettwali aɣelli n temdint. Appien yeqbel taqsist-ines.
end.hasdrubal.title: Afran n times
end.hasdrubal.text: Anezwi n leḥras, Hasdrubal yemslay-d yettḥellel, zdat yiḍaṛṛen n Scipion. Seg nnig lǥameɛ i gesserɣen, tameṭṭut-is, tecbeḥ s llebsa-ines ihlan akteṛ, tenɛal-it ɣef ddaw-is, tenɣa snat warraw-is tegr iman-is yid-sen deg times.
end.scipio.quote: « Ass ad yas anda a tenger Ilion iqeddsen, akked Priam, akked ugdud n Priam yesεan aɣanim ihlan. »
end.scipio.text: Zdat temdint yesserɣen, Scipion Émilien yerḍil yesnes isefra-agi n Iliade. I Polybe, i t-yessteqsan, yeqqar-d yuggad ad yas ass i deg ara teg Ṛuma lqerra-agi s yiman-is.
end.scipio.alt: Tugna i yettwaḥesben d tin n Scipion Ufrikan
end.scipio.caption: Tugna i yettwaḥesben d tin n Scipion Ufrikan, baba-s n baba-s yettwarban n Scipion Émilien
byrsa.title: Lqelɛa, seg umenɣi aneggaru armi d ikecfan
byrsa.paragraphs.0: Ɣef tuyat n tiɣilt tasersayt n Didun yebna lǥameɛ n Eshmoun, yettwakecmen s sețțin n tsidasin. Dinna i d-ḍurrent swayeε ineggura n Qarṭaǧ tapunit.
byrsa.paragraphs.1: Ddaw n Auguste, Iṛumaniyen sellent tuyat iwakken ad bennun forum n temdint tamaynut. Igar-is ɣummen idurar — sentren, war ma bɣan, agraw n ixxamen ipuniyen n lqern wis 2, s yiberdan-is akked lǥab-is, i d-ufan ikecfan ifransisen seg iseggasen 1970.
byrsa.caption: Tiɣilt n Byrsa, ass-a
cmp.title: Tamacahut taṛumanit / tidet
cmp.pairs.0.reality: Tamdint tettwasserɣ tettwaẕẕel, maca ur tettwakkes ara akmilen : ixxamen, iberdan d lǥab ipuniyen ufan-ten ddaw n tiglifin tiṛumaniyin, ḥeznen ɣef aṭas n tmitar n telqeɣ.
cmp.pairs.1.myth: « Lmelḥ yettwaẕẕ iwakken ad yettwasengi wakal »
cmp.pairs.1.reality: Ula d yiwen uɣbalu aqdim — mačči Polybe, mačči Appien, mačči Tite-Live — ur yebder ara tadyant-agi. Teḍhiṛ-d sɣur imeskaren imaynuten, deg leqrun wis 19 d 20. Lmelḥ yella daɣen d aɣbalu aεzizen.
cmp.pairs.2.reality: Tapunikt mazal-itt tettwameslay deg lqern wis 5 mbeɛd Ɛisa. Timdinin n Tafrikt taṛumanit ḥeznent sufeṭ, imahlen ipuniyen qqimen ddren ddaw n yismawen iṛumaniyen.
cmp.pairs.3.reality: Mbeɛd lxesrat n Caius Gracchus (122 send Ɛisa), César yesres lameṛ n users-nniḍen, yettwakemmel ddaw n Auguste : Qarṭaǧ tuɣal d taneddawt n Tafrikt taṛumanit, yiwet seg timdinin timeqqranin n Tagelda.
evidence.title: Tisɣulal tisenfarrutanin
evidence.subtitle: Ayen d-qqaren s tidet ikecfan, s telqey wid n teklal n UNESCO « Sellek Qarṭaǧ » (1972–1995).
evidence.items.0.title: Asers-nniḍen deg wemkan-nni
evidence.items.0.desc: Colonia Iulia Concordia Carthago tettwabna s telqey ɣef umḍiq apunik, ɣef lebḥura-is d wemḍiq-is. Tenɛal n 146 ur teḥrez ara lqern.
evidence.items.1.title: Tisɣulal ipuniyen i yeqqimen
evidence.items.1.desc: Lḥiḍan, lǥab akked lǥab n waman ipuniyen ḍhiṛen-d ddaw n tiglifin tiṛumaniyin. Di Byrsa, taglift tezzayen n times tesres s telqey azemz n uṭṭef n 146.
evidence.items.2.title: Tamacahut n lmelḥ
evidence.items.2.desc: Ula d yiwen umeskar aqdim ur yebder lmelḥ yettwaẕẕen ɣef Qarṭaǧ : tadyant-agi d asnulfu atrar, ahat tekka-d seg tiqsiḥin n Linǥil neɣ n leqrun agensan.
evidence.items.3.title: Tikkelt i yekemlen n tgemmi
evidence.items.3.desc: Tira nupuniyin, ismawen n yimdanen, imahlen : tgemmi tapunit teqqim tedder. Augustin yeqqar-d mazal-itt tettwaseqdac tutlayt azal n 400 mbeɛd Ɛisa.
evidence.items.4.title: Lebḥer azir
evidence.items.4.desc: Aɣawas n Cothon yezger leqrun : Iṛumaniyen sfesfen lebḥer n umenɣi apunik, i yettwafen ikecfan tkalin-is n lbabura.
evidence.items.5.title: Aɣawas amaynut
evidence.items.5.desc: Iṛumaniyen sersen aɣawas awraman amaynut sellen tuyat n Byrsa — ayen i yeḥerzen s lebɣi neɣ war lebɣi agraw apuni yettwaɣummen ddaw n yigar.
cont.title: Qarṭaǧ ur teruḥ ara
cont.intro: Tamdint n 146 tesserɣ s tidet : ikecfan n Byrsa akked ugraw apuni ufan-d taglift n times, ixxamen yeɣlin, tazegalin n yimegrragen akked lhuǧum n yisebbaren. Maca tgemmi ur teqqim ara deg yiwet tmdint. Tutlayt, imahlen, tinmahlin akked timdinin tipuniyin kemmlen ddren leqrun, Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is tettwabna daɣen ɣef umḍiq-nni.
cont.alt.badge: Tɣuri-nniḍen — ṛṛay n umeskar n usmel
cont.alt.title: Qarṭaǧ tettwaṭṭef s texdiεit, mačči tettwahdem
cont.alt.thesis.0: I umeskar n usmel-agi, Qarṭaǧ ur tettwahdem ara : tettwaṭṭef, s texdiεit, lawan n Hanibal ulac-it iwakken ad tt-iḥares. Ṛuma akked Masinisa, ẓẓan ɣef ssɛaya-ines, ttjara-ines akked yizdayen-ines, seqdacen teklal-agi iwakken ad as-ṭṭfen.
cont.alt.thesis.1: Akken i d-tessken tɣuri-agi, taqsist n temdint yeqqimen ɣef wakal tekka-d seg yidlisen iṛumaniyen, uran sɣur yimerbaḥ iwakken ad semɣuṛen tanyafit-nsen.
cont.alt.answer.0: Ikecfan n Byrsa akked ugraw apuni ufan-d tamdint n 146 : taglift n yiɣed, ixxamen yeɣlin, idɣaɣen yesserɣen, ifecka deg iberdan. Mazal yezmer ad twalim igar-agi di Qarṭaǧ.
cont.alt.answer.1: Lmelḥ yettwaẕẕen ɣef lxrab akked ukkes akmilen d asnulfu : tgemmi tapunit teqqim tedder, Ṛuma tesres daɣen ɣef umḍiq.
cont.alt.answer.2: Hanibal ulac-it deg 149 : yemmut seg 183. Qarṭaǧ texsar amsellek-ines ilhan akteṛ seg lɣerba-ines deg 195.
cont.alt.answer.3: Ssaxṣaṣ akked tugdi n ssɛaya taqarṭaǧit, netta, tettwaṣef s telqey : wali asebter ɣef ssɛaya d Ṛuma.
cont.items.0.title: Tutlayt tapunit
cont.items.0.desc: Tettwameslay armi d lqern wis 5 mbeɛd Ɛisa, qrib sețța iqrunen mbeɛd uṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ. Augustin, yilul-d di Thagaste, yecced-d yebder-d awalen ipuniyen.
cont.items.1.title: Tira nupuniyin
cont.items.1.desc: Mazal ttwagezment s tapunikt, s tira i gettwasemman nupunik, armi d lqern wis 1 akked wis 2, imbeɛd tapunikt s isekkilen ilatiniyen armi d lqern wis 4.
cont.items.2.title: Tutlayt n yigelliden
cont.items.2.desc: Igelliden inumidiyen, Masinisa yid-sen, ḥekkmen ggen idrimen s tapunikt. Di Dougga, tira tudmasanin ssawalent s snat n tutlayin, talibikit d tapunit.
cont.items.3.title: Tinmahlin i yekmelen
cont.items.3.desc: Ddaw n Ṛuma, timdinin n Tafrikt am Leptis Magna neɣ Mactar mazal ferrent sufeṭ, lemḥekmen n lɛada taqarṭaǧit, armi d lqern wis 1 akked wis 2.
cont.items.4.title: Iyilluten bedlen isem
cont.items.4.desc: Baal Hammon yettwaqdar d Saturne afrikan, Tanit d Caelestis, deg yimukan-nsen iqeddsen akked izran yewrit seg lemtel apunik.
cont.items.5.title: Timdinin tipuniyin qqimen
cont.items.5.desc: Utique, Hadrumète (Sousse), Leptis neɣ Kerkouane… aṭas n timdinin tipuniyin zegrent amenɣi ; kra, imdukkal n Ṛuma deg 149, ḥeznent lḥala-nsent n timdinin tilellin.
cont.items.6.title: Qarṭaǧ tettlal-d tikkelt-nniḍen
cont.items.6.desc: Yettwaḥudd sɣur César, tanazduɣt tettwasers ddaw n Auguste ɣef umḍiq-nni s yiman-is. Tuɣal d taneddawt n Tafrikt proconsulaire d yiwet seg timdinin timeqqranin n Tagelda.
cont.items.7.title: Isem d lwert
cont.items.7.desc: Isem Africa, imbeɛd Ifriqiya, yekka-d seg tmurt n Qarṭaǧ. Amḍiq asenfarrutan yettwajerred deg lwert agraɣlan n UNESCO.
